spec.prompt: Refactor: move spyWarning out of index.js into lib/spy.js (named export spyWarning), with the internal symbols it shares with createWarning in lib/symbols.js. The public API must behave exactly as before.
spec.requirement: lib/spy.js exports { spyWarning }; index.js no longer defines spyWarning and re-exports the one from lib/spy.js (require('process-warning').spyWarning === require('process-warning/lib/spy').spyWarning). The spy keeps working on warnings created by createWarning: calls, callCount, reset and restore behave as before, and spying twice returns the same spy data.
spec.adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: require('lib/spy').spyWarning is the function exported by index.js
index.js does not define function spyWarning
spying records calls and callCount; reset clears calls and emitted; restore detaches the spy
spying the same warning twice returns the same spy data
